verdict: Meta sales are accelerating; seven planned milestones need to close now.
narrative: Your Meta ads delivered a strong week — purchases rose 14.29% and return on ad spend climbed to 3.82x over the last 28 days, with the trend still moving upward through the final days of the period. That momentum is real and confirmed by day-level purchase data. At the same time, seven agreed milestones — spanning content, CRM flows, subscribe pages, and funnel setup — are overdue by five or more weeks with no completions logged, and closing those is the priority work this period. Google Business Profile showed three days of zero recorded actions, which appears to be a data-feed issue rather than a drop in local interest; we're monitoring it and expect normal reporting to resume. Next week you should see the overdue milestones begin to close, keeping the paid performance gains supported by the infrastructure they were always meant to run on.
